gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-days-one: Approachable, almost chunky, Days One fills the line with a big x-height while Funnel Display above it bends every stroke like glass tubing. Days One keeps long paragraphs friendly, its rungs of spacing carrying the eye along without a snag.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-epunda-sans: Funnel Display looks like spaghetti bent into capitals, every stroke the same width. Epunda Sans follows in a plain sans with oversized e and a counters, so a long passage feels spacious and easy going.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-farro: Funnel Display draws its letters in spaghetti-thin strokes of one width, with c tips that never drift toward touching. Farro then steps in as a sans with compressed ascenders and no stroke contrast, giving that loose heading a tidy partner.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-fragment-mono: Structured is the last thing you'd expect beside Funnel Display's looping, spaghetti-like strokes, yet here it is. Fragment Mono lines its letters up like nails on a ruler, and the tall waist line keeps each row tidy under that showy heading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-geist-mono: Funnel Display bends its same-width strokes into a commanding, spaghetti-like heading with an expressive streak. Geist Mono, a monospace with fixed-width code-style letters and lowercase that rises high, makes a longer stretch read like a tidy ledger of big side gaps.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-genos: Funnel Display's lowercase a has no thin hairlines at all, just one tubular stroke shaped into letters. Genos does the opposite job as a sans, pressing glyphs close and swelling gently along its curves so reading never snags.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-geom: Funnel Display makes its horizontals match its verticals in thickness, a commanding, expressive heading with a spaghetti-like line. Geom's lofty lowercase band feels friendly beside it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-hammersmith-one: Hammersmith One reads clean and rounded, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase, each stroke like a cut length of cord. Funnel Display above it adds expressive spaghetti lines.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-inder: Spaghetti-thin and commanding, Funnel Display cuts every stroke to one width, which gives the heading real swagger on the page. Inder sits below as a sans with little height difference between cases.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-jaldi: Funnel Display holds a constant stroke from top to baseline, spaghetti-like and expressive, with c tips that never creep together. And Jaldi, brushed on with a tall x-height and a gaping c, keeps a longer passage approachable and brisk.
